title: GPTQ 风格量化：per-channel 缩放 + 反量化 MSE
code:
W = [0.31, -0.92, 1.47, -0.05, 0.78, -1.20, 2.10, -0.66]
def quantize_int4(w, bits=4):
    max_abs = max(abs(x) for x in w)
    scale = max_abs / (2**(bits-1) - 1)
    q = [round(x / scale) for x in w]
    return q, scale
q, scale = quantize_int4(W)
deq = [x * scale for x in q]
err = sum((a-b)**2 for a,b in zip(W, deq)) / len(W)
print("scale:", round(scale,4))
print("量化值(int4):", q)
print("MSE:", round(err,6))
